entries.text:
# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

Mhojea Deva ! Tuka zannun gheuncho ani tji puja korchi dekhun tuvem mhaka nirmila hem mhaka purai khobor asa. Hanv okett-dubilo tor Tum upatt-bollixt. Hanv fonit-dubilo tor Tum phobor asa han hnya khinnak manu hnya.
Soimi ani sonkottant adar diupi oso Tum. Tujebogor anik dauro Dev na.
